description_en: Sends verification codes to an end user by using a specified channel, such as Short Message Service (SMS), Voice, and WhatsApp
description_zh: 通过指定的通道向最终用户发送验证码，支持的通道有短信、语音、和whatsapp
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi-intl start-verification --channel SMS --to 6212345000001 --service-sid FA00000000000001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartVerification

parameters.help_en: The channels that you can use for verification
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number of the recipient. You must add the country code to the beginning of the mobile phone number
parameters.help_zh: 接收短信号码。号码格式为：国际区号+号码
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The service ID that is displayed in the Phone Number Verification Service console
parameters.name: service_sid

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that was returned for the request

Model.description_en: The data that was returned only if the request was successful
Model.description_zh: 请求结果数据，如果请求成功则返回

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. An ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for a request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: 

true: The request was successful. 

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
 
false：调用失败
